title: Qaidi Ek Aisi Bhi Tareeq Me Miljaati Hai
body:
QAIDI EK AISI BHI TAREEQ ME MILJAATI HAI
MARKE BHI QAIDO SITAM SE NA RIHA PAATI HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
1. HAA WAHI DUQTARE SHABBIR SAKEENA MAASOOM
ISKE JAISA KOI DEKHI NA GAYI HAI MAZLOOM
AAJ BHI SHAAM SE HOKAR YE SADA AATI HAI……..
<<DIVIDER>>
2. BEGUNNAH KOI BHI QAIDI NA HO GHAMQAAR NA HO
AUR YATEEMI KA BHI USPAR KOI GHAMBAAR NA HO
AAJ BHI QABRE SAKEENA SE SADA AATI HAI…….
<<DIVIDER>>
3. USKE NAAZUK SE GARDAN ME JO BAANDHI THI RASAN
HAAI WO SAATH MOHARRUM SE  THI JO TASHNADAHAN
KAMSINI ME YE SITAM  KAISE WO SEHPATI HAI……
<<DIVIDER>>
4. KAAN SE QOON HAI AUR AANKHO SE HAI AANSU HAI RAWAA
AUR RUQSAAR PE ZAALIM KE TAMAACHO KE NISHA
KHUD KE SAAYE KO BHI WO DEKH KE DARJAATI HAI……
<<DIVIDER>>
5. APNE SEENE PE SULAATE THE SAKEENA KO HUSSAIN
AUR GODI ME KHILAATE THE SAKEENA KO HUSSAIN
HAA WAHI YAAD USE AAJ BHI TADPATI HAI…….
<<DIVIDER>>
6. ROSHNI BHULGAYI CHAAR BARAS KI BACHI
KAYI DIN SE THI WO ZINDAAN ME BHOOKI  PYAASI
LAADLI SHAH KI ZINDAAN ME GASH KHAATI HAI….
<<DIVIDER>>
7. KABHI AAGOSH ME ZAINAB KE JO SONA USKA
KABHI DEEWARO SE TAKRAKE WO RONA USKA
ZINDAGI GHAM KE ANDHERO ME GUZAR JATI HAI…..
<<DIVIDER>>
8. AAS CHUTI HAI JO MAZLOOM KE SEENE KI USE
AAS CHUTI HAI ANDHERE ME MADEENE KI USE
CHAIN MAZLOOM WO ZINDAA ME KAHA PAATI HAI….
<<DIVIDER>>
9. NAUHA MAZLOOMA KA ALTHAF-O-NAQI LIKHTE HAI
QAAK UDAATE HAI ALI AUR YE SADAA DETE HAI
AAJ BHI LEHDE SAKEENA PE SITAM HOTE HAI…
